GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 4th 1x1 2 1/2 Lengths off leader/winner No Pace On , Under Pressure x 400m - # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at start. Pass 600m, steadied after improving onto heels whilst over-racing.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted out and wider Straightening Up , ran on hitting Lead 30m from the line. [Stewards: Began awkwardly and was obliged to settle further back than intended.] # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After beginning awkwardly was obliged to settle further back than intended. Had some difficulty obtaining clear running at the entrance of the home straight. Laid in under pressure over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a half length, held together much same to turn trailing a head, joined Lead at 400m, edged to a narrow Lead Straightening Up , kept going in straight. [Stewards: Proved difficult to load. Further barrier certificate required. Raced keenly early stages.] # won in headbobber
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Proved difficult to load. Barrier cert prior to it’s next start. Raced keen early. Laid in under pressure over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1 length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led by a half length turning, kept going in Straight and only Headed inside the final 100m. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # led/battled on ok

Jumped awkwardly missing start 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, laid out home turn then Held Ground in straight. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME) # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and was slow into stride. Near the 400m, shifted in and brushed. Inclined to lay out round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1 length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led a half length turning, Headed 400m and Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Warning placed on it for being difficult to load. Unplaced $3-30 favourite. App. jockey reported it raced flat attributing this to being second-up. Stewards questioned rider about the tempo and leading the race. She explained it began on terms and responded well when given a squeeze, picked up the bit and led in a comfortable tempo. She further added that she could not explain the overall performance other than racing flat. Trainer could not explain the performance subsequently advising it had pulled up well.] # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Unplaced $3.30 favourite. Rdr reported mount raced flat & attributed this to mare being second up. When questioned about the tempo of the race & leading, Rdr explained after beginning on terms with the bulk of the field, gave mount a squeeze & mare responded well, picking up the bit & travelling up in the lead at a tempo felt was comfortable.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well landing on the lead didn't push on content to settle 3 Lengths away fence (800m), closer Turn , sweating on a run Straight , off Leaders back 150, bang! Went to the front & held closing rivals # got the run/used it

Slow out then worked forward out wide, trailed 1.25 Lengths Four Wide as the field settled down, pressed on and moved to 3 Wide Outside Lead at 1000m, took Lead at 900m and crossed prior to the 800m, Held Together in front & led 2 Lengths turning, kicked away Straightening Up and kept going in Straight # bolted in
Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a half length, moved to within a half head turning, Dropped Out in Straight # weakened noticeably
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on several occasions and became unbalanced rounding the home turn.
